name: pipaya-extension-server-sync
description: Mirrors the settings of a primary pipaya server onto this one (model connections, defaults, MCP servers, skills, tools).
author: dohwi

descriptions.en: Mirrors the settings of a primary pipaya server onto this one (model connections, defaults, MCP servers, skills, tools).
descriptions.ko: 기준(pimary) 서버의 설정을 이 서버로 그대로 가져옵니다(모델 연결, 기본값, MCP 서버, 스킬, 도구).

settings.label: Role
settings.description: primary keeps its own settings and serves them; follower pulls and applies

settings.label: Peer server URL
settings.description: Base URL of the other server, e.g. http://100.85.51.107:8787

settings.label: Peer admin token
settings.description: The other server's admin token (dataDir/token). Sent only to the URL above.

settings.label: Extra settings keys
settings.description: Comma-separated extra settings-table keys to mirror, beyond the built-in list
